title: LGTD: Local-Global Trend Decomposition for Season-Length-Free Time Series Analysis (code and data)
description: Source code, synthetic and real-world datasets, baseline wrappers, and experiment scripts for LGTD: Local-Global Trend Decomposition for Season-Length-Free Time Series Analysis. LGTD decomposes a time series into a smooth global trend, piecewise-linear local trends whose recurrence acts as emergent seasonality, and a residual, without a season-length parameter. The archive reproduces every table and figure in the paper: decomposition accuracy on nine synthetic benchmarks, Ljung-Box residual diagnostics on ETTh1, ETTh2, and the SILSO sunspot series, and the runtime and memory scaling study. Install with pip install -e . for the method alone, or pip install -e ".[experiments]" for the full benchmark. OneShotSTL additionally requires a Java runtime.
